name: EvoNext Holdings S.A.
summary: EvoNext Holdings SA is in the process of liquidation of its remaining assets. Previously, the company was engaged in discovery, research, development, and commercialization of nature-based ingredients for use in flavor and fragrances, health ingredients, health protection, and other sectors. The company was formerly known as Evolva Holding SA and changed its name to EvoNext Holdings SA in July 2025. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Reinach, Switzerland.
